gloss: to roll up; to keep doing (suffix)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: まくっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to roll up; to turn up; to tuck up
definitions.explanation: To fold or roll something (such as sleeves, a skirt, or pages) upward or back.

definitions.gloss: to keep doing; to do vigorously (verb suffix)
definitions.explanation: Attached to the stem of another verb to express doing something continuously or enthusiastically. Written as 〜まくる.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}かった→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦ズボン→ズボン：01072_zubon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裾|すそ}→裾：06488_suso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まくった。
examples.english: It was hot, so I rolled up my pant legs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧まくった。
examples.english: On my day off, I ate non-stop all day long.

examples.japanese: ⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧まくってしまい、⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|から}→空：27640_kara⟧になった。
examples.english: I went on a buying spree at the sale and emptied my wallet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦カーペット→カーペット：24239_kaapetto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まくって、⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧たまったほこり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: During the big clean-up, I rolled up the carpet and cleaned the dust that had accumulated underneath.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{二時間|にじかん}→二時間：27637_nijikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦しゃべり→しゃべる：02117_shaberu⟧まくって、⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧⟦やめる→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦{気配|けはい}→気配：00206_kehai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: She talked non-stop on the phone for two whole hours and showed no sign of stopping.

notes:
まくる has two distinct uses.

SENSE 1 (ROLL UP):
Also written as {捲|まく}る. A godan verb meaning to physically roll or fold something back.
- ⟦{袖|そで}→袖：02217_sode⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まくる: to roll up sleeves
- ⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まくる: to turn pages
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まくる: to flip up the futon

SENSE 2 (SUFFIX 〜まくる):
Attached to the ます-stem of verbs to emphasize doing something repeatedly, excessively, or with great vigor. Informal and emphatic.
- ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧まくる: to eat like crazy
- ⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧まくる: to run all over the place
- ⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧まくる: to have a blast; to play non-stop
